'''''Omze's Incredible Traveling Starport''''', originally named '''''Allanthia''''', was a [[Neutron Star-class bulk cruiser/Legends|''Neutron Star''-class bulk cruiser]].

==History==
[[File:Human_arrested.jpg|thumb|left|200px|A [[Human/Legends|Human]] being arrested by [[Ne'Chak]]'s security onboard ''Omze's Incredible Traveling Starport'']]
Acquired by the former [[Sludir]] [[Gladiator/Legends|gladiator]] [[Omze'kehr Kahr]], the ship was transformed into a mobile [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] by the addition of three large [[Hangar/Legends|docking bays]] into the ship's former cargo hold.

Following his [[Mission to Sulon|presumed death]] on [[Sulon/Legends|Sulon]], the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] infochant [[8t88/Legends|8t88]] was seen on the starport with the head of an [[ASP-series labor droid/Legends|ASP-series droid]].<ref name="Katarn">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=swminis/article/kylekatarnstale|series=Kyle Katarn's Tale|text=Mission 1}}</ref>
